title: Grant admin role to current user

requirements.text: Add a backend function that allows a bootstrapped super-admin principal (hardcoded or set on first call when no admin exists) to grant the admin role to a given principal. On canister initialization, automatically assign the admin role to the deployer's principal so the first user can self-promote.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'setAdmin' or equivalent function exists that can assign admin role to a principal
On first deploy (no existing admins), the canister deployer principal is automatically set as admin
Calling 'isAdmin' with the deployer's principal returns true after initialization

requirements.text: Add an admin self-promotion UI flow: when a logged-in Internet Identity user visits the Admin page and is not yet an admin, display a 'Claim Admin Access' button that calls the backend to grant them admin privileges (only succeeds if no admin exists yet or they are already an admin). After a successful claim, refresh the admin status and grant access to the AdminPanel.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Claim Admin Access' button is shown to authenticated users who are not yet admins on the Admin page
Clicking the button calls the backend grant-admin function
On success, the user is immediately granted access to the AdminPanel without a page reload
If the claim fails (e.g., admin slot already taken), an informative error toast is shown
AdminGuard correctly reflects the new admin status after claiming

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any files under frontend/src/components/ui
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture)
nonGoals: Role-based permission tiers beyond the existing admin/user distinction
Any changes to the booking flow or other existing features
